note: Congregations of every tradition found in San Francisco, listed in no order of importance; the city has hundreds more. Service times come from a congregation's own page or bulletin where one could be read; most Catholic Mass times come from Catholic Church Times and mosque listings from Zabihah, third-party directories, and those entries are marked for review. No Sikh gurdwara and no Hindu temple other than the Vedanta Society was found within the city in sources opened. Events are public programs at congregations from Nov 4 to Dec 19, 2026; Hanukkah runs Dec 4 to 12, but no 2026 Hanukkah programs (including the Union Square menorah lightings) were posted on pages that could be opened. services.name: GLIDE Daily Free Meals
services.what: Free breakfast, lunch and dinner; no eligibility requirements or intake form. About 1,700 meals a day, 364 days a year.
services.when: Breakfast 7:30 to 9 am (7:30 to 8 am reserved for seniors, families and adults with disabilities); lunch 11:30 am to 1 pm including Saturday and Sunday; dinner 3:30 to 5 pm, Monday to Sunday
services.note: Run by GLIDE. GLIDE's meals page says special meals are served at Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas and New Year's Eve; 2026 dates were not posted on that page when checked Nov 4.
services.review_note: The meals page has no update date (footer shows 2025) and lists holiday meals without a year; confirm 2026 holiday dates on GLIDE's events calendar.

services.name: St. Anthony's Dining Room
services.what: Free meals; breakfast dine-in or to go, lunch dine-in only, afternoon hot meal to go
services.when: Open 7 days a week: breakfast from 7 am; lunch 10 am to 1:30 pm (dine-in only); afternoon hot meal at 2 pm, to go only, Monday to Friday
services.where: St. Anthony's, 121 Golden Gate Ave., 1st floor
services.note: Run by St. Anthony Foundation. Its site also lists a free clothing program, a tech lab and a medical clinic. No 2026 Thanksgiving or Christmas meal details were posted on the dining room page when checked Nov 4.
services.review_note: Breakfast end time not given. The page footer lists 150 Golden Gate Ave. while the hours section gives 121 Golden Gate Ave.

services.name: Third Baptist Church Feed the Hungry

services.note: Run by Third Baptist Church. Info line 510-439-5279.
